findings.title: Main content takes too long to appear (LCP 8.34 s)
findings.evidence: LCP 8.34 s, median of 3 cold loads, Moto G-class Android, 4G. Threshold for "good" is 2.50 s.
findings.impact: On Moto G-class Android, 4G, the largest thing on screen finishes drawing after 8.34 s. Google treats anything over 2.5 seconds as poor; it affects both search ranking and how many visitors leave before the page is usable.
findings.fix: Identify the LCP element (recorded in perf.json as `lcpElement`) and shorten its path: serve it at the size it is displayed, in a modern format, without waiting on JavaScript or a render-blocking stylesheet.

findings.title: Page freezes while scripts run (TBT 2.32 s)
findings.evidence: TBT 2.32 s, median of 3 cold loads, Moto G-class Android, 4G. Threshold for "good" is 200 ms.
findings.impact: The page is unresponsive to taps and clicks for about 2.32 s while JavaScript runs. On a mid-range phone this reads as the site being broken rather than slow.
findings.fix: Reduce and defer JavaScript: split bundles by route, load non-essential third-party scripts after interaction, and move heavy work off the main thread or to the server.

findings.fix: Reduce and defer JavaScript: split bundles by route, load non-essential third-party scripts after interaction, and move heavy work off the main thread or to the server.
